evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Speaker supplies the decision as established fact, controlling the informational frame rather than invoking authority or arguing for it.
Evidence-and-logic argument for the switch; the benefits (performance, cost savings) function as offered rewards reinforcing the decision.
Summary entry restating the decision as an established item, controlling the informational record without invoking positional authority.
Quantified benefit presented as evidence supporting the decision — classic rational-persuasion structure.
Fixing a deadline imposes temporal pressure on the migration, an insistence tactic anchoring the decision to a date.
